summary: Sanction to convert agricultural land into commercial, institutional, or industrial operational use.
estimated_total_cost: Scrutiny fee + Conversion charges based on master plan zone

steps.title: Master plan zone verification
steps.description: Confirm whether land falls inside designated urbanizable boundary in city master plan.

steps.title: Comprehensive project report (CPR)
steps.description: Prepare project report showing proposed land use, access road width, water demand, and effluent treatment.

steps.title: Submit CLU application online
steps.description: Submit Jamabandi, Aks Shajra, non-encumbrance certificate, and scrutiny fee on state town planning portal.

steps.title: Inter-departmental clearance (IDC)
steps.description: Public works, forest, irrigation, and pollution boards examine site access and flood plains.

steps.title: Grant of In-Principle CLU & Letter of Intent
steps.description: Director of Town Planning issues formal CLU sanction order upon payment of conversion charges.
